Cream cable-knit sweater over white scalloped collar with muted blue narrow ribbon bow; matching soft cream calf-length A-line knit skirt, bare lower legs, cream low-heel Mary Jane shoes. Slender healthy 177 cm stature. Exactly three equally spaced full-body views of ONE SAME person in one horizontal row: strict FRONT at left, strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-left in center, strict 180-degree BACK at right.
